full_judgment: 8. After hearing the learned Advocates of both the parties and on perusal of the impugned judgments and orders alongwith the deposition of the witness which are annexed to the supplementary affidavit filed by the petitioner it appears to me, that the Assistant Judge committed illegality in allowing the prayer of the judgment debtor made under Order IX, rule 13 of the Civil Procedure Code. I hold the view that it is unnatural that a suit was decreed ex-parte without serving any notice upon the Government. I find no reason for the Government machinery not to know about any suit instituted against the Government. Moreover, the suit was decreed long before 17 years. After obtaining the decree the petitioner by filing a Miscellaneous Case corrected the khatian and got it prepared in his name in 1988, and since then he has been paying rent to the Government. After correction of the khatian by the responsible Government officers and after receiving rent from the petitioner I find no scope to say that the Government was not aware of the ex-parte decree passed long before 17 years. Apparently, the judgments of the Courts below are illegal.
